{{Quote|Thus we triumph! I invoke the Path of Blood!''"<br />"''I will remember you Mistress!''"<br />"''No. You won't.|The First Witch of the Wyrd and her second-in-command, as the First Witch slew her assistant to call upon the Path of Blood|<ref name="19 BBY" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]] served as the '''second-in-command''' of the [[Wyrd]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]] [[Coven/Legends|coven]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Circa [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the second-in-command assisted an effort by the Wyrd to corrupt Cularin's [[ch'hala tree]] and was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by the coven's [[First Witch of the Wyrd|First Witch]] to invoke a rite that was intended to kill the ch'hala [[Heart Tree]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|No! Mistress! They have broken the ritual! We cannot turn The Heart, now!|The Wyrd second-in-command, to the First Witch of the Wyrd|<ref name="19 BBY" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]] lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and became a member of the [[Wyrd]], a [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]] active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The Tarasin was younger than the [[First Witch of the Wyrd]], the coven's aged leader, and was appointed as the Wyrd's second-in-command and the First Witch's [[Aide/Legends|assistant]] and designated successor.<ref name="APOD" />

By the later stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Wyrd had suffered various setbacks and were reduced in number.<ref name="APOD" /> Circa [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="19 BBY">''[[Heart of Evil: A Plague of Darkness|A Plague of Darkness]]'' is set shortly before ''[[Heart of Evil: A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance|A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance]]'', a [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] adventure that occurs concurrently with the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. As the battle is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the events of ''A Plague of Darkness'' can be placed in circa 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the second-in-command was among a group of the remaining Wyrd members who joined an effort by the First Witch to corrupt Cularin's [[ch'hala tree]]s, a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] common across the world, in order to allow the Wyrd to gain control of the planet's ecology and thereby attain dominance on Cularin. To initiate the plan, the second-in-command accompanied the First Witch and the Wyrd's [[Inner Circle]] of senior witches to the [[Heart Tree]], the planet's foremost ch'hala tree. There, under the protection of a contingent of the [[Wyrd elite guard]], they commenced a [[Ritual of the Power of the Dark|ritual]] through which the witches sought to turn the Heart Tree to the dark side of the Force.<ref name="APOD" />

{{RPG|''[[Heart of Evil: A Plague of Darkness|A Plague of Darkness]]''}}
After the witches had been performing their ritual for eleven [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], they fell under [[First skirmish at the Heart Tree|attack]] from a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] and were forced to abandon the ritual, much to the distress of the second-in-command. As a final ploy to achieve victory for the Wyrd, the First Witch sought to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the ch'hala by invoking the [[Path of Blood]], an ancient dark side rite that drew power from the death of an individual. The second-in-command incorrectly believed that the First Witch planned to take her own life to call upon the rite and watched on eagerly as the First Witch brandished a [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long [[Color/Legends|black]] metallic rod, anticipating the First Witch's imminent demise. The First Witch instead stabbed her second-in-command in the [[Breast/Legends|breast]] to supplicate the Path of Blood and the Tarasin screamed loudly as she died. Her death triggered the discharge of an immense torrent of red-colored energy that tormented and sickened the Heart Tree. However, the ch'hala tree was saved after the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] merged his consciousness with the tree to assist it in repelling the dark power unleashed by the Wyrd second-in-command's passing.<ref name="APOD" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
The second-in-command was ambitious and relished the prospect of ascending to the leadership of the Wyrd.<ref name="APOD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wyrd second-in-command was created by [[Ronald A. Heintz]] and appeared in ''[[Heart of Evil: A Plague of Darkness|A Plague of Darkness]]'', a [[2005]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure set within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity which served as the first instalment of the [[Heart of Evil trilogy]] of [[RPGA]]'s Living Force roleplaying campaign. In the adventure, the players roleplay as the freelance agents that challenge the Wyrd at the Heart Tree. It is possible for the player characters to kill the First Witch of the Wyrd during their initial attack on the witches gathered at the ch'hala tree, in which case the second-in-command becomes leader of the Wyrd and sacrifices another of the witches to invoke the Path of Blood. Otherwise, if the First Witch is not killed during the agents' opening assault then the First Witch murders her second-in-command to entreat the dark side rite.<ref name="APOD" />
